jobs.text: Adroitent - Senior Java & TypeScript Developer - Payment Processing Job Description:We are seeking a highly experienced Senior Java & TypeScript Developer to take ownership of critical enterprise applications, integration components, and their ongoing operational health supporting payment processing and core business operations.
